title: The sweep reads the claim surface: comments as input, per-run surface readability report, fileless-claim warnings, actively-wrong fixture
objective: Close #282: a protocol whose claims are invisible to its own verification tool is not a protocol yet -- make the comment surface readable, make unread surfaces loud, and make fileless claims warn instead of vanish.
business_value: Four allocation incidents in one session; the instrument gets fixed before the AET-B phase that depends on clean id discipline.
in_scope: scripts/badf_id_sweep.py: optional comments.txt surface (scanned; ids at/above computed next-free produce a named WARNING, never folded into max); SURFACES header reporting each surface READ-with-count or NOT PROVIDED, every run; trailer updated to name what remains blind (unpushed worktrees, independent clones)

tests/test_badf_id_sweep.py: red-first -- warning on comment id above next-free; NOT-PROVIDED reported when comments.txt absent (with backward compat green); SURFACES header lists provided surfaces; the actively-wrong fixture (ledger says one id, comment claims another)
docs/governance/GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md: the dump recipe gains the comments one-liners; the protocol section names comments as the binding-claim surface the tool now reads
badf/demands/BADF-DEM-0115.json; reconcile WP-2026-0127; own composition record + typed G07 self-dossier
out_of_scope: any gate code; worktree scanning (stays the ask-half, named in the trailer); changing next-free semantics (#199 prose-pollution rule stands -- comments warn, never advance max)
acceptance_criteria: with comments.txt provided and containing an id at or above the claim-shaped next-free, the report carries a WARNING naming the id and the surface, and next-free is unchanged
with comments.txt absent, the run succeeds (backward compatible) and the SURFACES header states comments NOT PROVIDED -- an unread surface stated, never omitted
the SURFACES header lists every surface with READ-plus-count or NOT PROVIDED, every run
the actively-wrong case (ledger file id X, comment claims Y at/above next-free) shows both and warns (the fixture from the field)
all pre-existing sweep tests stay green; repo PASS on branch and composed tree; and no other encoding of the same defect survives -- every dump input x reporting path enumerated (the #270 clause)

test_obligations.claim: the comment surface is read when provided, loudly absent when not, and fileless claims warn at the point of allocation

evidence: failing-first: the four new cases red against the comment-blind tool
mutation: warning branch, NOT-PROVIDED report, header emission each neutered -> red

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR
